hypothesis: Replacing straight-ray Marmousi travel time with source-dependent eikonal travel time will reduce the per-record oracle-scaled Ricker template median calibration relative L2 below 0.5.
expected_mechanism: If r43 failed mainly from travel-time phase error, an eikonal wavefront should create nonzero template-target correlation without changing waveform or amplitude assumptions.

single_conceptual_variable.name: travel_time_model
single_conceptual_variable.candidate: grid eikonal on the saved velocity

primary_metric: median train-only calibration relative L2 after per-record oracle scaling
rollback: Preserve r43-r45; if rejected, stop tuning single-arrival travel-time features and move to a multi-arrival or latent propagator representation.
